claim: In May, the Guardian reported how a man whose testicular tissue was frozen before he had chemotherapy as a child and retransplanted 16 years later had been able to produce sperm.
label: TRUE
annotatorNote: PET/BioNews, 11 May 2026, citing a Guardian article of 4 May 2026: a man who 'had received extensive chemotherapy as a child' (sickle cell disease) had testicular tissue cryopreserved; 'Sixteen years later, the tissue fragments were thawed and grafted back'; spermatogenesis in two grafts and 'a single mature sperm cell'. 'Able to produce sperm' holds, on a non-peer-reviewed preprint. The Guardian's own page was not retrieved.
